events.verdict: Turner (IND) is in a legal guarding position when he absorbs the initial contact with Jokic (DEN) during his drive to the basket.
Turner (IND) cleanly blocks Jokic's (DEN) shot attempt and any contact with Jokic's hand on the ball is considered incidental.
Nembhard (IND) places his off-arm against Gordon (DEN), whose momentum carries him forward as Nembhard comes to a stop.
Turner (IND) places his hand against Gordon (DEN) with slight extension as he releases away to roll to the basket, but the contact is marginal.
Gordon (DEN) legally contests Haliburton's (IND) jump shot attempt.
Nembhard (IND) jumps to the contest and turns his body into Braun (DEN), affecting his driving shot attempt.
Watson (DEN) places a hand on Turner's (IND) body after the release of his jump shot attempt and the contact is marginal.
Jokic's (DEN) pass goes off of Westbrook's (DEN) hand and into the backcourt, where he illegally recovers the ball.
Braun (DEN) commits a take foul on Nesmith (IND).
Turner (IND) and Westbrook (DEN) engage with one another and the contact is marginal. Westbrook is not dislodged from his position as a result of the marginal contact.
Turner (IND) legally contests Jokic's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Porter Jr. (DEN) commits a take foul on Haliburton (IND).
